card.name: First digit of multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A leading digit (often 1, 2, 3 or 4) that begins a multi-digit number in dosing, trial results or dosimetry text. The number is usually split so that more digits follow.

modes.label: Digit in calculations
modes.description: Leading digit of a tablet strength or divisor in a dose formula.

modes.description: Leading digit of a percentage or count in a trial comparison.
